name: Quadruple Chile Cheeseburgers

ingredients.name: chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce

instructions.secondary_message: 1 chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce

instructions.primary_message: Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over half of coal grate. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to high heat. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil the grilling grate.

Meanwhile, divide meat into 4 even piles and shape into burger patties about 1.5-cm wider than burger buns. Season generously with salt and pepper and set aside. Combine chipotle, adobo sauce, and mayonnaise in a small bowl. Stir to combine. Set aside.

Place poblano chiles directly over lit coals or gas burners, turning occasionally, until charred and blistered all over. Transfer to a sheet of aluminum foil and wrap tightly. Set aside for 5 minutes, then remove from foil and carefully peel off most of skin. Discard stems and seeds. Roughly chop chiles.

Place burgers directly over hot side of grill and cook, turning occasionally, until well charred and internal temperature registers 52°C to 54°C (51°C-54°C) on an instant-read thermometer for medium-rare, about 5 minutes total, or 57°C to 60°C (57°C-60°C) for medium, about 6 minutes total. Top each burger patty with 2 slices of cheese, then transfer to a large plate and tent with aluminum foil.
Toast buns directly over hot side of grill until browned, about 30 seconds.
Place bottom buns on a cutting board. Top with burger patties. Top burger patties with roasted chiles and pickled jalapeños. Top with chipotle mayonnaise. Close sandwiches and serve.

description: A fat patty of grilled beef draped with a melty, oozy slice of pepper jack cheese, topped with roasted green chiles, and a handful of pickled jalapeños, served on a hearty bun with a generous swipe of chipotle mayonnaise. This is the burger that bites back.
notes: Optional substitutions: whole fresh poblano chiles → Hatch chiles; pepperjack colby-jack cheese → pepper colby-jack cheese
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
